ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 4:1 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Right lobe distal region contains a high-intensity white polygon with internal low-intensity points. Left lobe distal region displays a heterogeneous mixture of high and low intensity pixels in a mottled configuration. Medial regions are uniformly low-intensity.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped indentation with a calculated vertex angle of ~68 degrees and a vertical depth approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous trailing edge exhibits multi-scale serration; left lobe shows higher frequency/lower amplitude peaks compared to the right lobe which features more pronounced singular indentations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe boundaries follow an upward convex curve from the median notch towards the distal terminal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 4-6 discrete, high-intensity circular pixel clusters on the lower medial section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible thin, linear segments of higher intensity (light grey) cutting through the low-intensity field on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Primary structural anomaly: a large, semi-circular indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe, deviating from the expected linear serration pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast dark circular point isolated within the largest white patch on the distal right lobe.
